title: Memory concern review

user_facing_items.final_wording: Supports flexible or prescheduled monitoring, review of emerging needs, a named coordinator, and documented care and support planning.
user_facing_items.population: Adults with suspected or diagnosed dementia and their carers.
user_facing_items.setting: Initial assessment, specialist assessment, ongoing care coordination, and support.
restrictions: Exact for adult memory and cognitive concern assessment and support; partial for undifferentiated memory symptoms and not directly validated for UAE referral, driving, or social-care pathways.
user_facing_items.rationale: Supports patient and collateral history, cognitive symptoms, function, tools and reversible-cause assessment for memory concerns; no decision is generated.
